title: MK10-PRO Ingest Manifest Schema
description: Content-addressed ingest manifest that binds all root DAG inputs explicitly. No filesystem discovery. No defaults. No inference.

manifest_version.description: Schema version (semver). Required for deterministic parsing.

ingest_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of ingest. Required for evidence.

assets.description: Array of ingested assets. Must contain at least one asset. All root DAG inputs must be present.

asset_id.description: Unique identifier for this asset within the manifest. Must be unique across all assets.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of asset content (hexadecimal, lowercase). Required for content addressing.

hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used. Currently only sha256 supported. No defaults.

role.description: Declared role of this asset. Maps to root DAG node input requirements. Must match DAG node input expectations exactly.

metadata.description: Immutable metadata for this asset. Must be canonical JSON. No defaults. All fields must be explicitly declared.

size.description: Asset size in bytes. Required if applicable.

mime_type.description: MIME type if known. Not inferred.
